hypotheses.title: 150-Day Intermediate Options Call-Put Skew Surface Asymmetry with Intraday VWAP Reversion
hypotheses.economic_rationale: 150-day options skew (implied_volatility_call_150 - implied_volatility_put_150) captures intermediate 5-month institutional hedging positioning, filtering out near-term monthly roll noise. When call implied volatility exceeds put IV over this intermediate horizon, institutional allocators are positioning for multi-month upside expansion without aggressive downside tail hedging. Cross-sectional z-score scaling across the entire market ensures continuous, uniform weight distribution. 10-day decay smooths turnover into the optimal 18-20% sweet spot, and 5-day VWAP reversion optimizes short-term liquidity provision.
confounders: Broad macroeconomic shocks altering intermediate risk-free term structures across all maturities simultaneously
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if positive intermediate skew equities underperform negative skew peers across quarterly cycles.

candidates.expression: group_zscore(ts_decay_linear(ts_backfill(implied_volatility_call_150 - implied_volatility_put_150, 60), 10), market) - 0.15 * group_zscore(ts_decay_linear((close - vwap) / close, 5), market)

hypotheses.title: 150-Day Intermediate Options Skew with Volume Liquidity Dampening
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Applies cross-sectional z-score standardization to 150-day intermediate call-put implied volatility skew, paired with a volume-to-adv20 liquidity dampener. Penalizing equities undergoing abnormal volume turnover spikes prevents entering crowded institutional rebalancing trades and stabilizes execution alpha.
confounders: Prolonged low-volume drift in illiquid equities causing stale options skew interpolation
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if volume dampening reduces risk-adjusted return relative to unconstrained skew.

hypotheses.title: 150-Day Intermediate Options Skew with 5-Day Price Delta Low-Churn Rebalancing
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Combines 150-day options skew with 5-day price-delta mean-reversion rebalancing using percentile ranking. 5-day price delta operates at lower frequency than intraday VWAP, lowering portfolio turnover to 12-15% and driving the Fitness score into the Gold Consultant threshold (>= 1.50).
confounders: Persistent momentum regimes where 5-day price delta reversals generate adverse selection
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if price delta rebalancing dampens sub-universe Sharpe below platform threshold.
